method: Non-parametric bootstrap (n=2000 resamples, seed=42) over per-record (true,pred) pairs reconstructed exactly from the confusion matrices in reports/evaluation_achievable_v2.json (rq2.confusion_matrix, orientation-verified against reported point estimates before use; rq3.source_clause_preservation_metrics.confusion_matrix likewise). Macro-F1 averaged over classes with nonzero true support in the full sample, matching the point-estimate computation.
note: Regenerated 2026-07-17 to match the declared official run (v2). Reconstruction verified: reproduced point estimates match reported values to <0.01 before bootstrapping.

historical_v1.method: Non-parametric bootstrap (n=2000 resamples, seed=42) over per-record true/pred label pairs reconstructed exactly from the confusion matrices in reports/evaluation_achievable.json (rq2.confusion_matrix and rq3.source_clause_preservation_metrics.confusion_matrix). The confusion matrix fully determines the multiset of (true,pred) pairs; only the mapping back to specific source documents is lost, which does not affect resampling validity. Reconstruction verified against the exact reported point estimates before use.
historical_v1.note_on_rq2_gap: RQ2 bootstrap mean (0.413) sits noticeably below the point estimate (0.491). This is expected, not an error: several classes have very small true-positive counts (Hidden Fee 1/18, Penalty Clause 4/10), so many bootstrap resamples exclude the single correct prediction for that class entirely, driving its F1 to 0 for that resample and pulling the macro-average down. The CI (0.328-0.499) still correctly brackets the true value and shows real uncertainty driven by small per-class sample sizes.
